<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sunley Technology Corporation — Field Database</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.2/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mammoth@1.7.0/mammoth.browser.min.js"></script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root[data-theme="light"]{
    --bg:#F6F6FC; --bg-alt:#FFFFFF; --card:#FFFFFF; --text:#0B0B33; --text-mut:#5C5C8F;
    --border:#E2E2F3; --accent:#04037C; --accent-soft:#E8E7F7; --accent-contrast:#FFFFFF; --navy:#04037C;
    --success:#178A55; --success-soft:#E3F6ED; --danger:#C2402F; --danger-soft:#FBE8E5;
    --warn:#B5790F; --warn-soft:#FBF0DC; --sidebar:#050349; --sidebar-text:#A6A6D8;
    --gold:#C8961F; --gold-soft:#F7EEDB; --gold-contrast:#241A05; --shadow:rgba(4,3,124,0.08);
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#07061F; --bg-alt:#121037; --card:#121037; --text:#E9E9F9; --text-mut:#9595C4;
    --border:#252358; --accent:#7472E8; --accent-soft:#1D1B4C; --accent-contrast:#0B0A26; --navy:#050344;
    --success:#3ED28E; --success-soft:#0E2A20; --danger:#F17766; --danger-soft:#2E1613;
    --warn:#F0BB4C; --warn-soft:#2E230D; --sidebar:#040330; --sidebar-text:#7C7CB4;
    --gold:#E8B65B; --gold-soft:#2E2410; --gold-contrast:#241A05; --shadow:rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; margin:0; transition:background .2s,color .2s;}
  .font-display{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;}
  .font-mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}
  .card{background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px var(--shadow), 0 1px 10px var(--shadow);}
  .card-hover{transition:transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;}
  .card-hover:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 6px 20px var(--shadow);}
  .input{background:var(--bg-alt); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text); border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:14px; width:100%;}
  .input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:-1px;}
  .btn{border-radius:9px; padding:8px 14px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent; transition:opacity .15s, transform .1s;}
  .btn:hover{opacity:.85;}
  .btn:active{transform:scale(.98);}
  .btn-accent{background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-contrast);}
  .btn-gold{background:var(--gold); color:var(--gold-contrast);}
  .btn-outline{background:transparent; border-color:var(--border); color:var(--text);}
  .btn-danger{background:var(--danger-soft); color:var(--danger); border-color:var(--danger);}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent; color:var(--text-mut);}
  .badge{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 9px; border-radius:999px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600;}
  .hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #030266 65%, var(--gold)); border-radius:16px; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 8px 30px var(--shadow);}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px; height:8px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border); border-radius:4px;}
  .bars span{display:inline-block; width:3px; background:var(--accent); border-radius:1px; margin-right:2px; animation:bar 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .bars span:nth-child(1){height:6px; animation-delay:0s;}
  .bars span:nth-child(2){height:10px; animation-delay:.12s;}
  .bars span:nth-child(3){height:14px; animation-delay:.24s;}
  .bars span:nth-child(4){height:18px; animation-delay:.36s;}
  @keyframes bar{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.55);} 50%{transform:scaleY(1);}}
  .sidebar-link{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:9px 14px; border-radius:8px; color:var(--sidebar-text); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer;}
  .sidebar-link:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:#fff;}
  .sidebar-link.active{background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-contrast);}
  .modal-backdrop{position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(4,6,20,.62); display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center; padding:40px 16px; overflow-y:auto; z-index:50;}
  table{border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:13px;}
  th{text-align:left; color:var(--text-mut); font-weight:600; font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  td{padding:9px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); vertical-align:top;}
  tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  a.link{color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; font-weight:600;}
  a.link:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
  @media print{
    .no-print{display:none !important;}
    body{background:#fff !important; color:#000 !important;}
    .card{border:1px solid #ccc !important; break-inside:avoid;}
    a.link{color:#000 !important;}
  }
</style>
</head>

/* ============================= STORAGE HELPERS ============================= */
// Uses Claude's window.storage when this runs as a Claude artifact; falls back to
// the browser's own localStorage when the file is opened directly (double-clicked,
// hosted elsewhere, etc.) so the app never hangs waiting on a storage API that
// isn't present, and data still persists across reloads either way.
const LS_PREFIX = 'sunley_db_';
function hasCloudStorage(){ return typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.storage; }
async function stGet(key, shared){
  if(hasCloudStorage()){
    try{ const r = await window.storage.get(key, shared); if(r) return JSON.parse(r.value); }
    catch(e){ /* fall through to local */ }
  }
  try{ const v = localStorage.getItem(LS_PREFIX+key); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : null; }
  catch(e){ return null; }
}
async function stSet(key, val, shared){
  let ok = false;
  if(hasCloudStorage()){
    try{ await window.storage.set(key, JSON.stringify(val), shared); ok = true; }
    catch(e){ /* fall through to local */ }
  }
  try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_PREFIX+key, JSON.stringify(val)); ok = true; }
  catch(e){ console.error('local storage write failed (data may be too large for this browser)', e); }
  return ok;
}

function normalizeEntity(e){
  e.contacts = e.contacts || [];
  e.products = (e.products||[]).map(p=>{
    const pf = p.files||{};
    return {
      id:p.id, name:p.name, image:p.image||null, description:p.description||'', notes:p.notes||'',
      files:{ datasheet:pf.datasheet||null, manual:pf.manual||pf.userManual||null, reference:pf.reference||pf.testReference||null }
    };
  });
  e.visitLogs = (e.visitLogs||[]).map(l=>({ ...l, analysis: l.analysis || {accomplished:[], nextSteps:[], remember:[]} }));
  e.reports = (e.reports||[]).map(r=>({ ...r, notes:r.notes||'', analysis: r.analysis || {accomplished:[], nextSteps:[], remember:[]} }));
  e.transactions = e.transactions || [];
  e.purchaseOrders = (e.purchaseOrders||[]).map(po=>({
    id:po.id, poNumber:po.poNumber||'', date:po.date||'', equipment:po.equipment||'', units:po.units||'', notes:po.notes||'',
    files:Object.assign({reference:null,datasheet:null,poc:null}, po.files||{})
  }));
  e.quotations = (e.quotations||[]).map(q=>({
    id:q.id, quoteNumber:q.quoteNumber||'', date:q.date||'', item:q.item||'', amount:q.amount||'', validUntil:q.validUntil||'', notes:q.notes||'',
    file:q.file||null
  }));
  return e;
}

async function loadEntity(id){
  if(S.entities[id]) return S.entities[id];
  const e = await stGet('entity:'+id, true);
  if(e){ normalizeEntity(e); S.entities[id]=e; }
  return e;
}
function saveEntity(e){ S.entities[e.id]=e; return stSet('entity:'+e.id, e, true); }
function saveIndex(){ return stSet('entity_index', S.index, true); }
function saveUsers(){ return stSet('sunley_users', S.users, true); }
function saveActivity(){ return stSet('activity_feed', S.activity, true); }
function saveSims(){ return stSet('sims_data', S.sims, true); }
function saveDirectory(){ return stSet('directory', S.directory, true); }
function saveReminders(){ return stSet('reminders', S.reminders, true); }

function pushActivity(entry){ S.activity.unshift(Object.assign({id:uid(), at:now(), entityId:null, entityName:''}, entry)); S.activity = S.activity.slice(0,200); saveActivity(); }

/* ============================= SIM AUTO-DEDUCTION ============================= */
// Tries a handful of common formats ("01 December, 2025", "1 Dec 2025", "2025-12-01")
// before giving up — SIM received/delivered dates were typed freehand in the source
// spreadsheets so formats vary.
function parseFlexDate(str){
  if(!str) return null;
  const d = new Date(str);
  if(!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d;
  return null;
}
function cutoffDateForMonth(carrier, year, month){
  if(CARRIER_CUTOFF_DAY[carrier]==='fixed10') return new Date(year, month, 10);
  return new Date(year, month+1, 0); // last day of month
}
// Counts how many of this carrier's cut-off dates fall in (fromDate, toDate].
function countCutoffsPassed(carrier, fromDate, toDate){
  if(!fromDate || !toDate || fromDate>=toDate) return 0;
  let count = 0;
  let y = fromDate.getFullYear(), m = fromDate.getMonth();
  for(let i=0;i<720;i++){ // safety cap: 60 years of months
    const cutoff = cutoffDateForMonth(carrier, y, m);
    if(cutoff > fromDate && cutoff <= toDate) count++;
    if(cutoff > toDate) break;
    m++; if(m>11){ m=0; y++; }
  }
  return count;
}
// Runs once per page load (and again whenever the SIMs tab is opened) — deducts
// one month for every carrier cut-off that has passed since the last check, and
// logs each deduction to that SIM's version history.
function runSimAutoDeductions(){
  const today = new Date();
  let changed = false;
  CARRIERS.forEach(carrier=>{
    (S.sims[carrier]||[]).forEach(r=>{
      if(!r.mobile) return; // pending SIM, nothing to deduct yet
      const remNum = parseInt(r.remaining,10);
      if(isNaN(remNum)) return; // blank or already 'PDIS' — not a numeric countdown
      const baseStr = r.lastDeduction || r.delivered || r.received;
      const baseDate = parseFlexDate(baseStr);
      if(!baseDate) return;
      const passed = countCutoffsPassed(carrier, baseDate, today);
      if(passed > 0){
        // Walk the cut-offs one at a time: a SIM can sit at 0 (its last, partial
        // month) for one cut-off cycle, then the NEXT cut-off with nothing left
        // flips it to "PDIS" instead of going negative.
        let remaining = remNum;
        let becamePDIS = false;
        for(let i=0;i<passed;i++){
          if(remaining > 0){ remaining -= 1; }
          else { becamePDIS = true; break; }
        }
        const newRem = becamePDIS ? 'PDIS' : String(remaining);
        r.history = r.history || [];
        r.history.push({date:now(), from:remNum, to:newRem, by:'System', note:`Auto-deducted after ${passed} cut-off${passed>1?'s':''} (${CARRIER_CUTOFF_LABEL[carrier]})${becamePDIS?' — no months left, marked PDIS':''}`});
        r.remaining = newRem;
        r.lastDeduction = today.toISOString().slice(0,10);
        changed = true;
      }
    });
  });
  if(changed) saveSims();
  return changed;
}

/* ============================= INIT / SEED ============================= */
async function init(){
  const theme = await stGet('theme_pref', false);
  S.theme = theme || 'light';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', S.theme);

  let users = await stGet('sunley_users', true);
  if(!users || !users.length){
    users = [
      {id:uid(), username:'admin', password:'admin123', role:'admin', fullName:'System Administrator'},
      {id:uid(), username:'manager', password:'manager123', role:'manager', fullName:'Marketing Manager'},
      {id:uid(), username:'staff', password:'staff123', role:'staff', fullName:'Field Marketing Staff'},
    ];
    await stSet('sunley_users', users, true);
  }
  S.users = users;

  let index = await stGet('entity_index', true);
  if(!index || !index.length){
    index = [];
    for(const name of SEED_SUPPLIERS) index.push({id:uid(), kind:'supplier', name, logo:null});
    for(const name of SEED_CLIENTS) index.push({id:uid(), kind:'client', name, logo:null});
    await stSet('entity_index', index, true);
    for(const item of index){
      const entity = {id:item.id, kind:item.kind, name:item.name, logo:null, notes:'',
        contacts:[], products:[], visitLogs:[], reports:[], transactions:[], purchaseOrders:[], quotations:[]};
      await stSet('entity:'+item.id, entity, true);
    }
  }
  S.index = index;

  let activity = await stGet('activity_feed', true);
  S.activity = activity || [];

  let sims = await stGet('sims_data', true);
  if(!sims){ sims = SIM_SEED; await stSet('sims_data', sims, true); }
  S.sims = {globe:sims.globe||[], smart:sims.smart||[], dito:sims.dito||[]};
  CARRIERS.forEach(carrier=>{
    S.sims[carrier].forEach(r=>{
      if(!r.id) r.id=uid();
      if(!r.history) r.history=[];
      if(r.lastDeduction===undefined) r.lastDeduction=null;
    });
  });
  runSimAutoDeductions();

  let directory = await stGet('directory', true);
  if(!directory || !directory.length){
    directory = DIRECTORY_SEED.map(d=>Object.assign({id:uid()}, d));
    await stSet('directory', directory, true);
  }
  directory.forEach(d=>{ if(!d.category) d.category='Other'; });
  S.directory = directory;

  let reminders = await stGet('reminders', true);
  S.reminders = reminders || [];

  let company = await stGet('company_info', true);
  if(!company){
    company = {name:'Sunley Technology Corporation', about:COMPANY_ABOUT_TEXT, logo:LOGOS.company.Sunley};
    await stSet('company_info', company, true);
  }
  S.company = company;

  let templates = await stGet('report_templates', true);
  if(!templates || !templates.length){
    templates = [{
      id:uid(), category:'Monthly Equipment Sales Report',
      title:'Monthly Equipment Sales & Performance Report (blank format)',
      notes:'Activity, Pipeline, and Equipment Fulfilment Tracker — the standard monthly format for sales reps.',
      summary:SEED_TEMPLATE_FILE.summary,
      file:{name:SEED_TEMPLATE_FILE.name, type:SEED_TEMPLATE_FILE.type, size:SEED_TEMPLATE_FILE.size, data:SEED_TEMPLATE_FILE.data},
      uploadedBy:'System', uploadedAt:now(),
    }];
    await stSet('report_templates', templates, true);
  }
  S.templates = templates;

  S.ready = true;
  render();
  backgroundSync();
  startClockTick();
}

async function backgroundSync(){
  let anyChange = false;
  await Promise.all(S.index.map(async item=>{
    try{
      let e = S.entities[item.id];
      if(!e){ e = await stGet('entity:'+item.id, true); if(e){ normalizeEntity(e); S.entities[item.id]=e; } }
      if(!e) return;
      let dirty=false;
      const logoMap = LOGOS[item.kind]||{};
      const logo = logoMap[item.name];
      if(logo && !e.logo){ e.logo=logo; item.logo=logo; dirty=true; }
      const prodList = SUPPLIER_PRODUCTS[item.name];
      if(prodList && prodList.length && e.products.length===0){
        e.products = prodList.map(n=>({id:uid(), name:n, image:null, description:'', notes:'',
          files:{datasheet:null,manual:null,reference:null}}));
        dirty=true;
      }
      if(dirty){ saveEntity(e); anyChange=true; }
    }catch(err){ console.error('sync error for', item.name, err); }
  }));
  if(anyChange){ saveIndex(); }
  S.preloaded = true;
  render();
}

/* ============================= AUTH ============================= */
function handleLogin(ev){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const u = (f.get('username')||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const p = f.get('password')||'';
  const found = S.users.find(x=>x.username.toLowerCase()===u && x.password===p);
  if(found){ S.user = found; S.loginErr=''; S.tab='dashboard'; render(); pushActivity({type:'login', by:found.fullName, summary:'logged in'}); }
  else { S.loginErr = 'Incorrect username or password.'; render(); }
  return false;
}
function logout(){ S.user=null; S.entityId=null; render(); }
function can(action){
  if(!S.user) return false;
  const r = S.user.role;
  if(action==='manageUsers') return r==='admin';
  if(action==='deleteEntity') return r==='admin'||r==='manager';
  if(action==='deleteRecord') return r==='admin'||r==='manager';
  return true;
}

function toggleTheme(){
  S.theme = S.theme==='light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', S.theme);
  stSet('theme_pref', S.theme, false);
  render();
}
function goTab(tab){ S.tab=tab; S.entityId=null; if(tab==='sims'){ runSimAutoDeductions(); } render(); }
function openEntity(id){
  S.entityId=id; S.entityTab='overview'; S.entityLoadError=null;
  if(S.entities[id]){ render(); return; }
  render();
  loadEntity(id).then(e=>{ if(!e){ S.entityLoadError=id; } render(); })
    .catch(()=>{ S.entityLoadError=id; render(); });
}

/* ============================= FILE HELPERS ============================= */
function readFileAsData(file){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    if(!file){ resolve(null); return; }
    if(file.size > 2*1024*1024){ reject(new Error('File is larger than 2MB. Please use a smaller file for this database.')); return; }
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = ()=> resolve({name:file.name, type:file.type||'application/octet-stream', size:file.size, data:r.result});
    r.onerror = ()=> reject(new Error('Could not read file.'));
    r.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
function previewBlock(f){
  if(!f) return '<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No file.</div>';
  if(f.type && f.type.startsWith('image/')) return `<img src="${f.data}" class="rounded-lg border max-h-64 object-contain" style="border-color:var(--border)"/>`;
  if(f.type==='application/pdf') return `<embed src="${f.data}" type="application/pdf" class="w-full rounded-lg border" style="height:360px;border-color:var(--border)"/>`;
  const ext = (f.name.split('.').pop()||'').toUpperCase();
  return `<div class="card p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
    <div class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent)">${ext}</div>
    <div class="flex-1"><div class="text-sm font-semibold">${esc(f.name)}</div><div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${(f.size/1024).toFixed(0)} KB — preview not supported in-browser for this format</div></div>
    <a href="${f.data}" download="${esc(f.name)}" class="btn btn-outline">Download</a>
  </div>`;
}
function fileFieldBlock(name,label,fileObj){
  return `<div>
    <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${label}</label>
    ${fileObj?`<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs mb-1 mt-1" style="color:var(--accent)"><span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${esc((fileObj.name.split('.').pop()||'').toUpperCase())}</span><a class="link" href="${fileObj.data}" download="${esc(fileObj.name)}">${esc(fileObj.name)}</a></div>`:''}
    <input class="input mt-1" name="${name}" type="file"/>
  </div>`;
}
// Compact one-line file reference used in lists — avoids rendering multiple heavy
// PDF/image previews at once (that was a source of the browser freezing up).
// Full preview only renders on demand inside previewModal().
function fileChipLine(f, label, previewCall){
  if(!f) return '';
  const ext = (f.name.split('.').pop()||'').toUpperCase();
  return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-1 flex-wrap">
    ${label?`<span style="color:var(--text-mut); min-width:70px;">${esc(label)}</span>`:''}
    <span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${ext}</span>
    <span class="font-medium truncate" style="max-width:180px;">${esc(f.name)}</span>
    <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="padding:2px 8px;" onclick="${previewCall}">Preview</button>
    <a class="link text-xs" href="${f.data}" download="${esc(f.name)}">Download</a>
  </div>`;
}
// Looks a file up live from state by reference instead of embedding base64 into
// onclick attributes (keeps the DOM light and avoids ever rendering more than
// one heavy preview — e.g. a PDF — on screen at the same time).
function getFileRef(eid, section, recordId, fileKey){
  if(section==='template'){ const t=S.templates.find(x=>x.id===recordId); return t?t.file:null; }
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  if(!e) return null;
  if(section==='report'){ const r=e.reports.find(x=>x.id===recordId); if(!r) return null; const v=r.versions[r.versions.length-1]; return {name:v.fileName,type:v.fileType,size:v.size,data:v.fileData}; }
  if(section==='reportVersion'){ const r=e.reports.find(x=>x.id===recordId); if(!r) return null; const v=r.versions.find(x=>String(x.v)===String(fileKey)); return v?{name:v.fileName,type:v.fileType,size:v.size,data:v.fileData}:null; }
  if(section==='product'){ const p=e.products.find(x=>x.id===recordId); return p?p.files[fileKey]:null; }
  if(section==='po'){ const po=e.purchaseOrders.find(x=>x.id===recordId); return po?po.files[fileKey]:null; }
  if(section==='quotation'){ const q=e.quotations.find(x=>x.id===recordId); return q?q.file:null; }
  return null;
}
function previewModal(eid, section, recordId, fileKey){
  const f = getFileRef(eid, section, recordId, fileKey);
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-2xl" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 gap-3">
      <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold truncate">${f?esc(f.name):'File not found'}</div>
      <div class="flex gap-2 shrink-0">
        ${f?`<a class="btn btn-outline" href="${f.data}" download="${esc(f.name)}">Download</a>`:''}
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    ${f?previewBlock(f):'<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">This file could not be found — it may have been replaced or removed.</div>'}
  </div>`;
}

/* ============================= PREDICTION MODEL ============================= */
function outcomeVal(o){ return o==='positive'?1:o==='neutral'?0.5:0; }

/* ============================= NOTE ANALYSIS ENGINE ============================= */
// Pattern/keyword based — NOT a language model. It scans visit-log notes (and any
// notes + extracted .docx text attached to an uploaded report) for sentences that
// look like completed items, follow-up actions, or things worth remembering, and
// pulls a due date out of any action sentence that mentions one ("tomorrow",
// "next Friday", "Aug 25", "8/25", etc.) to raise as a Dashboard reminder.
// It will miss things phrased unusually and occasionally flag a false positive —
// treat it as a first pass, not a substitute for reading the actual note.
const AI_DONE_RE = /\b(discussed|presented|delivered|signed|closed|completed|provided|demonstrated|finished|submitted|met with|visited|reviewed|confirmed|agreed|installed|resolved|walked through|showcased|handed over)\b/i;
const AI_TODO_RE = /\b(will|need to|needs to|to do|todo|action item|follow[- ]?up|next step|should|must|plan to|going to|have to|required to|schedule|prepare|send|deliver|submit|arrange|coordinate|await|awaiting|pending)\b/i;
const AI_REMEMBER_RE = /\b(note|important|remember|key point|reminder|caution|fyi|please be advised|keep in mind)\b/i;
const AI_WEEKDAYS = ['sunday','monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday'];
const AI_MONTHS = 'jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec';

function extractDueDate(sentence, baseDate){
  const s = sentence.toLowerCase();
  let d = new Date(baseDate.getTime());
  if(/\btomorrow\b/.test(s)){ d.setDate(d.getDate()+1); return d; }
  if(/\bnext week\b/.test(s)){ d.setDate(d.getDate()+7); return d; }
  if(/\bnext month\b/.test(s)){ d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+1); return d; }
  let m = s.match(/\bin (\d+) days?\b/);
  if(m){ d.setDate(d.getDate()+parseInt(m[1],10)); return d; }
  m = s.match(/\b(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\b/);
  if(m){
    const target = AI_WEEKDAYS.indexOf(m[1]);
    const cur = d.getDay();
    let diff = (target - cur + 7) % 7; if(diff===0) diff=7;
    d.setDate(d.getDate()+diff);
    return d;
  }
  const re1 = new RegExp('\\b('+AI_MONTHS+')[a-z]*\\.?\\s+(\\d{1,2})(st|nd|rd|th)?(,?\\s+(\\d{4}))?\\b','i');
  m = sentence.match(re1);
  if(m){
    const year = m[5] ? parseInt(m[5],10) : baseDate.getFullYear();
    const candidate = new Date(`${m[1]} ${m[2]}, ${year}`);
    if(!isNaN(candidate.getTime())){
      if(!m[5] && candidate < baseDate) candidate.setFullYear(year+1);
      return candidate;
    }
  }
  m = sentence.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})(\/(\d{2,4}))?\b/);
  if(m){
    const year = m[4] ? (m[4].length===2 ? 2000+parseInt(m[4],10) : parseInt(m[4],10)) : baseDate.getFullYear();
    const candidate = new Date(year, parseInt(m[1],10)-1, parseInt(m[2],10));
    if(!isNaN(candidate.getTime())){
      if(!m[4] && candidate < baseDate) candidate.setFullYear(year+1);
      return candidate;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
function analyzeText(text, baseDateStr){
  const result = {accomplished:[], nextSteps:[], remember:[], reminders:[]};
  if(!text || !text.trim()) return result;
  const baseDate = parseFlexDate(baseDateStr) || new Date();
  const sentences = text.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(s=>s.length>3).slice(0,80);
  sentences.forEach(sentence=>{
    const isTodo = AI_TODO_RE.test(sentence);
    const isDone = AI_DONE_RE.test(sentence);
    const isRemember = AI_REMEMBER_RE.test(sentence);
    if(isTodo){
      result.nextSteps.push(sentence);
      const due = extractDueDate(sentence, baseDate);
      if(due) result.reminders.push({text:sentence, dueDate:due.toISOString().slice(0,10)});
    } else if(isDone){
      result.accomplished.push(sentence);
    } else if(isRemember){
      result.remember.push(sentence);
    }
  });
  return result;
}
// Best-effort .docx text extraction (via mammoth.js, loaded from CDN) so an
// uploaded report's own content — not just the notes box — feeds the analysis
// above. Falls back to just the notes box for any other file type, or if the
// mammoth library didn't load (e.g. no internet access).
async function extractFileText(file){
  if(!file || !window.mammoth) return '';
  if(!/\.docx$/i.test(file.name)) return '';
  try{
    const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({arrayBuffer:buf});
    return (result.value||'').slice(0,4000);
  }catch(err){ console.warn('docx extraction skipped:', err.message); return ''; }
}

function computePredictions(entity){
  const map = {};
  const logsSorted = [...entity.visitLogs].sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.date)-new Date(a.date));
  logsSorted.forEach(log=>{
    (log.products||[]).forEach(p=>{
      map[p] = map[p] || [];
      map[p].push(log);
    });
  });
  return Object.entries(map).map(([product, logs])=>{
    let wsum=0, wtot=0;
    logs.forEach((log,i)=>{ const w = Math.pow(0.82, i); wsum += w*outcomeVal(log.outcome); wtot += w; });
    const score = wtot ? wsum/wtot : 0;
    let label, colorVar;
    if(logs.length < 2){ label='Not enough data'; colorVar='--text-mut'; }
    else if(score >= 0.65){ label='Keep pushing'; colorVar='--success'; }
    else if(score >= 0.4){ label='Monitor / reassess'; colorVar='--warn'; }
    else { label='Reconsider pitch'; colorVar='--danger'; }
    return {product, score, label, colorVar, visits:logs.length, lastDate:logs[0].date, lastOutcome:logs[0].outcome};
  }).sort((a,b)=> b.score-a.score);
}

/* ============================= MODAL ============================= */
function openModal(html){ S.modal = html; render(); }
function closeModal(){ S.modal=null; render(); }

/* ============================= RENDER: ROOT ============================= */
function render(){
  const app = byId('app');
  if(!S.ready){ app.innerHTML = loadingScreen(); return; }
  if(!S.user){ app.innerHTML = loginScreen(); attachLoginHandlers(); return; }
  app.innerHTML = appShell();
  attachGlobalHandlers();
}

function loadingScreen(){
  return `<div class="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center" style="background:var(--bg)">

      <div class="text-sm font-mono" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Loading Sunley database…</div>
    </div></div>`;
}

          <input class="input mb-3 mt-1" name="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required/>
          ${S.loginErr ? `<div class="text-sm mb-3" style="color:var(--danger)">${esc(S.loginErr)}</div>` : ''}
          <button class="btn btn-accent w-full" type="submit">Log in</button>
        </form>
        <div class="text-xs mt-5 leading-relaxed" style="color:var(--text-mut)">
          Demo accounts — <span class="font-mono">admin / admin123</span> (Admin),
          <span class="font-mono">manager / manager123</span> (Manager),

function topbar(){
  return `<div class="flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 border-b no-print" style="border-color:var(--border); background:var(--bg-alt)">
    <div class="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
      <input id="searchBox" class="input" placeholder="Search clients, suppliers…" value="${esc(S.searchQ)}" oninput="onSearch(this.value)" onfocus="onSearch(this.value)"/>
      <div id="searchDropdown">${S.searchQ ? searchDropdown() : ''}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex-1"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="toggleTheme()" title="Toggle light/dark">${S.theme==='light'?'🌙 Dark':'☀️ Light'}</button>

      <div class="text-sm font-semibold">${esc(S.user.fullName)}</div>
      <div class="text-xs capitalize" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${esc(S.user.role)}</div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="logout()">Log out</button>
  </div>`;
}
// Only patches the small dropdown panel directly — does NOT call the global
// render(), which used to rebuild the whole page on every keystroke and made
// typing in the search box feel like it was dropping characters.
function onSearch(v){
  S.searchQ = v;
  const dd = byId('searchDropdown');
  if(dd) dd.innerHTML = v ? searchDropdown() : '';
}
function searchDropdown(){
  const q = S.searchQ.toLowerCase();
  const matches = S.index.filter(e=>e.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0,8);
  return `<div class="card absolute mt-1 w-full z-40 overflow-hidden" style="background:var(--bg-alt)">
    ${matches.length ? matches.map(m=>`<div class="px-3 py-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:opacity-75 flex items-center justify-between" onclick="S.searchQ='';goTab('${m.kind==='client'?'clients':'suppliers'}');openEntity('${m.id}');">
      <span>${esc(m.name)}</span><span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${m.kind}</span></div>`).join('')
      : `<div class="px-3 py-2 text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No matches.</div>`}
  </div>`;
}

function content(){
  if(S.entityId) return entityDetail(S.entityId);
  if(S.tab==='dashboard') return dashboard();
  if(S.tab==='ai') return aiAssistantPage();
  if(S.tab==='about') return aboutCompany();
  if(S.tab==='clients') return entityList('client');
  if(S.tab==='suppliers') return entityList('supplier');
  if(S.tab==='reports') return allReports();
  if(S.tab==='templates') return templatesPage();
  if(S.tab==='directory') return telDirectory();
  if(S.tab==='sims') return simsDatabase();
  if(S.tab==='timezones') return timezonesPage();
  if(S.tab==='logs') return activityLogPage();
  if(S.tab==='help') return helpGuide();
  if(S.tab==='users') return usersAdmin();
  return '';
}

/* ============================= DASHBOARD ============================= */
function dashboard(){
  const clients = S.index.filter(e=>e.kind==='client').length;
  const suppliers = S.index.filter(e=>e.kind==='supplier').length;
  const thisMonth = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7);
  const visitsThisMonth = S.activity.filter(a=>a.type==='visit' && (a.at||'').slice(0,7)===thisMonth).length;
  return `
  <div class="hero mb-6 flex items-center gap-4 p-7">
    <img src="${S.company.logo||LOGOS.company.Sunley}" style="width:52px;height:52px;object-fit:contain; background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:6px;"/>
    <div>
      <div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">Welcome back, ${esc(S.user.fullName.split(' ')[0])}</div>
      <div class="text-sm" style="color:#D6D6F5;">Strategic marketing database — clients, suppliers, visit logs & reports.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
    ${statCard('Clients', clients, '◈')}
    ${statCard('Suppliers', suppliers, '◇')}
    ${statCard('Visit logs this month', visitsThisMonth, '▤','--gold')}
  </div>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-6">
    ${remindersPanel()}
    ${summariesPanel()}
  </div>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
    <div class="card p-5">
      <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-3">Recent activity</div>
      ${S.activity.length ? `<div class="flex flex-col gap-3">${S.activity.slice(0,8).map(a=>`
        <div class="flex items-start gap-3 text-sm">
          <div class="badge shrink-0" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${a.type}</div>
          <div class="flex-1">${a.entityId?`<span class="font-semibold cursor-pointer" onclick="openEntity('${a.entityId}')">${esc(a.entityName)}</span>`:(a.entityName?`<span class="font-semibold">${esc(a.entityName)}</span>`:'')} ${a.entityName?'— ':''}${esc(a.summary)}
          <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${fmtDateTime(a.at)} · ${esc(a.by)}</div></div>
        </div>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No activity logged yet. Open a client or supplier to add a visit log or report.</div>`}
    </div>
    <div class="card p-5">
      <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-3">Quick access</div>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        ${S.index.slice(0,8).map(e=>`<div class="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border cursor-pointer text-sm flex items-center gap-2" style="border-color:var(--border)" onclick="goTab('${e.kind}s');openEntity('${e.id}')">
          ${logoThumb(e.logo,e.name,20)}<span class="truncate">${esc(e.name)}</span></div>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function remindersPanel(){
  const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  const active = S.reminders.filter(r=>!r.done);
  const overdue = active.filter(r=> new Date(r.dueDate) < today).sort((a,b)=> new Date(a.dueDate)-new Date(b.dueDate));
  const upcoming = active.filter(r=> new Date(r.dueDate) >= today).sort((a,b)=> new Date(a.dueDate)-new Date(b.dueDate));
  const list = [...overdue, ...upcoming].slice(0,8);
  return `<div class="card p-5">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-1">Reminders</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-3" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Follow-ups flagged automatically from visit logs and reports — pattern-matched, so double-check before acting.</div>
    <div id="remindersList" class="flex flex-col gap-2">${renderReminderItems(list, today)}</div>
  </div>`;
}
function renderReminderItems(list, today){
  return list.map(r=>{
    const overdueFlag = new Date(r.dueDate) < today;
    return `<div class="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
      <input type="checkbox" onclick="toggleReminder('${r.id}')" style="margin-top:3px;"/>
      <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
        ${r.entityId?`<span class="cursor-pointer font-semibold" onclick="openEntity('${r.entityId}')">${esc(r.entityName)}</span>`:''}
        <span style="color:var(--text-mut)"> — ${esc(r.text)}</span>
        <div class="text-xs" style="color:${overdueFlag?'var(--danger)':'var(--text-mut)'}">${overdueFlag?'Overdue — was due':'Due'} ${fmtDate(r.dueDate)} · ${esc(r.source)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No follow-ups flagged right now.</div>`;
}
function toggleReminder(id){
  const r = S.reminders.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!r) return;
  r.done = true;
  const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  const active = S.reminders.filter(x=>!x.done);
  const overdue = active.filter(x=> new Date(x.dueDate) < today).sort((a,b)=> new Date(a.dueDate)-new Date(b.dueDate));
  const upcoming = active.filter(x=> new Date(x.dueDate) >= today).sort((a,b)=> new Date(a.dueDate)-new Date(b.dueDate));
  const list = byId('remindersList');
  if(list) list.innerHTML = renderReminderItems([...overdue, ...upcoming].slice(0,8), today);
  saveReminders();
}
function summariesPanel(){
  const items = [];
  S.index.forEach(idx=>{
    const e = S.entities[idx.id]; if(!e) return;
    (e.visitLogs||[]).forEach(l=>{ if(l.analysis && (l.analysis.accomplished.length||l.analysis.nextSteps.length||l.analysis.remember.length)) items.push({date:l.date, entityId:e.id, entityName:e.name, title:'Visit on '+fmtDate(l.date), analysis:l.analysis}); });
    (e.reports||[]).forEach(r=>{ if(r.analysis && (r.analysis.accomplished.length||r.analysis.nextSteps.length||r.analysis.remember.length)) items.push({date:r.createdAt, entityId:e.id, entityName:e.name, title:r.title, analysis:r.analysis}); });
  });
  items.sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.date)-new Date(a.date));
  const top = items.slice(0,4);
  return `<div class="card p-5">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-1">Recent report summaries</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-3" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Auto-broken into accomplished / next steps / to remember from each entry's notes.</div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      ${top.map(it=>`<div class="pt-2" style="border-top:1px solid var(--border)">
        <div class="text-sm font-semibold cursor-pointer" onclick="openEntity('${it.entityId}')">${esc(it.entityName)} — ${esc(it.title)}</div>
        ${analysisSnippet(it.analysis)}
      </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Log a visit or upload a report with notes to see summaries here.</div>`}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function statCard(label,val,icon,colorVar){
  colorVar = colorVar || '--accent';
  return `<div class="card p-5 flex items-center gap-4">
    <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-lg" style="background:var(${colorVar}-soft); color:var(${colorVar})">${icon}</div>
    <div><div class="text-2xl font-display font-bold">${val}</div><div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${label}</div></div>
  </div>`;
}
function logoThumb(logo,name,size){
  if(logo) return `<img src="${logo}" style="width:${size}px;height:${size}px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;background:var(--bg-alt);" class="border" />`;
  const letter = (name||'?').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  return `<div style="width:${size}px;height:${size}px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:${size*0.45}px;">${letter}</div>`;
}

}
async function handleSaveCompany(ev){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  S.company.name = f.get('name'); S.company.about = f.get('about');
  const file = f.get('logo');
  if(file && file.size){ try{ const d = await readFileAsData(file); S.company.logo = d.data; }catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; } }

  saveCompany();
  pushActivity({type:'company', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:S.company.name, summary:'updated company profile'});

/* ============================= AI BUSINESS ASSISTANT ============================= */
// Two layers, so this page is useful whether or not the live model call succeeds:
// 1) A deterministic "Opportunity Forecast" built purely from data already in this
//    database (reuses the same recency-weighted scoring as the per-client
//    Strategic Insight tab, aggregated company-wide) — always available, no network.
// 2) A free-form chat that calls Claude with a summary of the company's data as
//    context. This only works when the page is running inside a Claude.ai
//    artifact/chat session that proxies the API call; opened as a plain local
//    file, the request will fail and the UI explains that plainly instead of
//    pretending to answer.
function computeCompanyForecast(){
  const opportunities = [];
  S.index.filter(idx=>idx.kind==='client').forEach(idx=>{
    const e = S.entities[idx.id];
    if(!e) return;
    computePredictions(e).forEach(p=>{
      if(p.label==='Not enough data') return;
      opportunities.push({clientId:e.id, client:e.name, product:p.product, score:p.score, label:p.label, colorVar:p.colorVar, visits:p.visits, lastDate:p.lastDate});
    });
  });
  opportunities.sort((a,b)=> b.score-a.score);

  const expiring = [];
  const in30 = new Date(); in30.setDate(in30.getDate()+30);
  S.index.forEach(idx=>{
    const e = S.entities[idx.id];
    if(!e) return;
    (e.quotations||[]).forEach(q=>{
      if(!q.validUntil) return;
      const vu = new Date(q.validUntil);
      if(vu >= new Date() && vu <= in30){
        expiring.push({entityId:e.id, entity:e.name, item:q.item, quoteNumber:q.quoteNumber, validUntil:q.validUntil, amount:q.amount});
      }
    });
  });
  expiring.sort((a,b)=> new Date(a.validUntil)-new Date(b.validUntil));

  return {opportunities: opportunities.slice(0,10), expiring};
}
function forecastPanel(){
  const {opportunities, expiring} = computeCompanyForecast();
  return `
  <div class="card p-5 mb-5">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-1">Top opportunities</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-3" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Ranked from visit-log outcomes across every client — same scoring as each client's Strategic Insight tab, company-wide.</div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      ${opportunities.map(o=>`<div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
        <div class="w-2 h-8 rounded-full shrink-0" style="background:var(${o.colorVar})"></div>
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <span class="font-semibold cursor-pointer" onclick="goTab('clients');openEntity('${o.clientId}');S.entityTab='prediction';">${esc(o.client)}</span>
          <span style="color:var(--text-mut)"> — ${esc(o.product)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="text-right shrink-0">
          <div class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(${o.colorVar})">${o.label}</div>
          <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${(o.score*100).toFixed(0)}/100</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Log a few visits with products tagged and outcomes recorded to populate this.</div>`}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="card p-5">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-1">Quotations expiring within 30 days</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-3" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Worth a follow-up call before these lapse.</div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      ${expiring.map(q=>`<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <div><span class="font-semibold cursor-pointer" onclick="openEntity('${q.entityId}')">${esc(q.entity)}</span> — ${esc(q.item)} ${q.quoteNumber?'(#'+esc(q.quoteNumber)+')':''}</div>
        <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--warn)">valid until ${fmtDate(q.validUntil)}</div>
      </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Nothing expiring soon.</div>`}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function aiAssistantPage(){
  return `
  <div class="mb-5">
    <div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">AI Business Assistant</div>

  </div>

}

async function handleAddEntity(ev, kind){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  let logo=null;
  const file = f.get('logo');
  if(file && file.size){ try{ const d = await readFileAsData(file); logo = d.data; }catch(e){ alert(e.message); return false; } }
  const id = uid();
  const entity = {id, kind, name:f.get('name'), logo, notes:f.get('notes')||'', contacts:[], products:[], visitLogs:[], reports:[], transactions:[], purchaseOrders:[], quotations:[]};
  S.entities[id] = entity;
  S.index.push({id, kind, name:entity.name, logo});
  closeModal();
  goTab(kind+'s');
  saveEntity(entity); saveIndex();
  pushActivity({type:'entity', entityId:id, entityName:entity.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`added as a new ${kind}`});
  return false;
}

          <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save</button>

async function handleEditEntity(ev,id){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const e = S.entities[id];
  e.name = f.get('name'); e.notes = f.get('notes')||'';
  const file = f.get('logo');
  if(file && file.size){ try{ const d = await readFileAsData(file); e.logo = d.data; }catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; } }
  const idx = S.index.find(x=>x.id===id); if(idx){ idx.name=e.name; idx.logo=e.logo; }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e); saveIndex();
  pushActivity({type:'entity', entityId:id, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:'profile updated'});
  return false;
}
function handleDeleteEntity(id){
  if(!confirm('Delete this profile and all its logs, reports and contacts? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  const name = S.entities[id] ? S.entities[id].name : (S.index.find(x=>x.id===id)||{}).name || 'Unknown';
  S.index = S.index.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  delete S.entities[id];
  closeModal();
  S.entityId=null; render();
  saveIndex();
  pushActivity({type:'entity', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:name, summary:'profile deleted'});
}

function entityTabContent(e){
  if(S.entityTab==='overview') return overviewTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='contacts') return contactsTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='products') return productsTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='visits') return visitsTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='reports') return reportsTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='quotations') return quotationsTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='purchaseOrders') return purchaseOrdersTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='transactions') return transactionsTab(e);
  if(S.entityTab==='prediction') return predictionTab(e);
  return '';
}

function handleSaveContact(ev,eid,cid){

function productModal(eid,pid){

  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">

      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Image (optional)</label>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-4">
        ${fileFieldBlock('datasheet','Datasheet', files.datasheet)}
        ${fileFieldBlock('reference','Reference', files.reference)}
        ${fileFieldBlock('manual','Manual', files.manual)}
      </div>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save</button>
      </div>

  </div>`;

async function handleSaveProduct(ev,eid,pid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const existing = pid ? e.products.find(x=>x.id===pid) : null;
  let image = existing ? existing.image : null;
  const imgFile = f.get('image');
  if(imgFile && imgFile.size){ try{ image = (await readFileAsData(imgFile)).data; }catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; } }
  const filesOut = Object.assign({datasheet:null,reference:null,manual:null}, existing?existing.files:{});
  for(const key of ['datasheet','reference','manual']){
    const file = f.get(key);
    if(file && file.size){
      try{ const d = await readFileAsData(file); filesOut[key] = {name:d.name,type:d.type,size:d.size,data:d.data}; }
      catch(err){ alert(key+': '+err.message); return false; }
    }
  }
  const data = {name:f.get('name'), image, description:f.get('description')||'', notes:f.get('notes')||'', files:filesOut};
  const filesAdded = ['datasheet','reference','manual'].filter(k=>f.get(k) && f.get(k).size);
  if(pid){ Object.assign(existing, data); }
  else { e.products.push(Object.assign({id:uid()}, data)); }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  pushActivity({type:'product', entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`${pid?'updated':'added'} product ${data.name}${filesAdded.length?' (uploaded '+filesAdded.join(', ')+')':''}`});
  return false;
}

/* ---- VISIT LOGS ---- */
function visitsTab(e){
  const logs = [...e.visitLogs].sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.date)-new Date(a.date));
  return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold">Meeting / visit logs</div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(visitModal('${e.id}'))">+ Add log</button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
    ${logs.map(l=>`<div class="card p-4">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div>
          <div class="font-semibold">${fmtDate(l.date)} — ${esc(l.location||'No location noted')}</div>
          <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Logged by ${esc(l.loggedBy)} ${l.attendees?'· Attendees: '+esc(l.attendees):''}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="badge" style="background:${outcomeColor(l.outcome,true)};color:${outcomeColor(l.outcome)}">${l.outcome}</span>
          ${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteRecord('${e.id}','visitLogs','${l.id}')">✕</button>`:''}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${l.products&&l.products.length?`<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">${l.products.map(p=>`<span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${esc(p)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`:''}
      <div class="text-sm mt-2">${esc(l.notes)}</div>
      ${analysisSnippet(l.analysis)}
    </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No visit logs yet.</div>`}
  </div>`;
}
// Compact "detected" strip shown under a visit log / report — flags this is
// pattern-matched, not a model's understanding of the text.
function analysisSnippet(a){
  if(!a || (!a.accomplished.length && !a.nextSteps.length && !a.remember.length)) return '';
  return `<div class="mt-2 pt-2 text-xs flex flex-col gap-1" style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border); color:var(--text-mut)">
    <div style="color:var(--text-mut); font-weight:600;">Detected from notes:</div>
    ${a.accomplished.length?`<div><span style="color:var(--success)">✓ Accomplished:</span> ${esc(a.accomplished.slice(0,2).join(' '))}</div>`:''}
    ${a.nextSteps.length?`<div><span style="color:var(--warn)">→ Next steps:</span> ${esc(a.nextSteps.slice(0,2).join(' '))}</div>`:''}
    ${a.remember.length?`<div><span style="color:var(--gold)">★ Remember:</span> ${esc(a.remember.slice(0,2).join(' '))}</div>`:''}
  </div>`;
}
function outcomeColor(o,soft){
  const c = o==='positive'?'success':o==='negative'?'danger':'warn';
  return `var(--${c}${soft?'-soft':''})`;
}
function visitModal(eid){
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Add visit / meeting log</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleAddVisit(event,'${eid}')">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Date</label><input class="input mt-1" name="date" type="date" value="${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}" required/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Location</label><input class="input mt-1" name="location" placeholder="e.g. Client HQ, Ortigas"/></div>
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Attendees</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="attendees" placeholder="Names of people present"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Outcome</label>
      <select class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="outcome">
        <option value="positive">Positive</option><option value="neutral">Neutral</option><option value="negative">Negative</option>
      </select>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Products / solutions pitched</label>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-1 mb-3">
        ${e.products.length ? e.products.map(p=>`<label class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" name="products" value="${esc(p.name)}" style="margin-right:4px;"/>${esc(p.name)}</label>`).join('') : `<span class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No products on file — add some in the Products tab to tag them here.</span>`}
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes</label>
      <textarea class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="notes" rows="3" placeholder="What was discussed, next steps, etc."></textarea>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save log</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
function handleAddVisit(ev,eid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const products = f.getAll('products');
  const log = {id:uid(), date:f.get('date'), location:f.get('location'), attendees:f.get('attendees'), outcome:f.get('outcome'), products, notes:f.get('notes')||'', loggedBy:S.user.fullName};
  const analysis = analyzeText(log.notes, log.date);
  log.analysis = {accomplished:analysis.accomplished, nextSteps:analysis.nextSteps, remember:analysis.remember};
  e.visitLogs.push(log);
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  pushActivity({type:'visit', entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`logged a visit (${log.outcome})`});
  if(analysis.reminders.length){
    analysis.reminders.forEach(r=> S.reminders.push({id:uid(), text:r.text, dueDate:r.dueDate, done:false,
      entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, source:'Visit log · '+fmtDate(log.date), createdAt:now()}));
    saveReminders();
  }
  return false;
}

/* ---- REPORTS ---- */
function reportsTab(e){
  return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold">Reports</div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(reportModal('${e.id}'))">+ New report</button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
    ${e.reports.map(r=>{
      const latest = r.versions[r.versions.length-1];
      return `<div class="card p-4">
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
          <div>
            <div class="font-semibold">${esc(r.title)} <span class="badge ml-1" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${esc(r.type)}</span></div>
            <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">v${latest.v} · uploaded by ${esc(latest.uploadedBy)} · ${fmtDate(latest.date)}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-1 no-print">
            <button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openModal(newVersionModal('${e.id}','${r.id}'))">Upload new version</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="openModal(versionHistoryModal('${e.id}','${r.id}'))">History (${r.versions.length})</button>
            ${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteRecord('${e.id}','reports','${r.id}')">✕</button>`:''}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-3">${fileChipLine({name:latest.fileName,type:latest.fileType,size:latest.size,data:latest.fileData}, null, `openModal(previewModal('${e.id}','report','${r.id}'))`)}</div>
        ${r.notes?`<div class="text-sm mt-2">${esc(r.notes)}</div>`:''}
        ${analysisSnippet(r.analysis)}
      </div>`;
    }).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No reports uploaded yet.</div>`}
  </div>`;
}
function reportModal(eid){
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-md" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">New report</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleAddReport(event,'${eid}')">
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Type</label>
      <select class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="type" onchange="byId('otherType').style.display=this.value==='Other'?'block':'none'">
        ${REPORT_TYPES.map(t=>`<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('')}
      </select>
      <input id="otherType" class="input mb-3" name="otherType" placeholder="Specify report type" style="display:none"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Title</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="title" placeholder="e.g. Q3 site visit — Globe Telecom" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes / summary (optional)</label>
      <textarea class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="notes" rows="3" placeholder="What happened, what's next, anything to remember — this gets scanned to surface follow-ups on the Dashboard. For .docx files, the document's own text is scanned too."></textarea>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">File (PDF, Word, Excel, image — max 2MB)</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="file" type="file" required/>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Upload</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
async function handleAddReport(ev,eid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  let type = f.get('type'); if(type==='Other' && f.get('otherType')) type = f.get('otherType');
  const rawFile = f.get('file');
  let fileData;
  try{ fileData = await readFileAsData(rawFile); }catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; }
  const extractedText = await extractFileText(rawFile);
  const notes = f.get('notes')||'';
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const report = {id:uid(), type, title:f.get('title'), notes, createdBy:S.user.fullName, createdAt:now(),
    versions:[{v:1, date:now(), fileName:fileData.name, fileType:fileData.type, size:fileData.size, fileData:fileData.data, uploadedBy:S.user.fullName, notes:'Initial upload'}]};
  const analysis = analyzeText(notes + (extractedText?'\n'+extractedText:''), report.createdAt.slice(0,10));
  report.analysis = {accomplished:analysis.accomplished, nextSteps:analysis.nextSteps, remember:analysis.remember};
  e.reports.push(report);
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  pushActivity({type:'report', entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`uploaded "${report.title}"`+(extractedText?' (text extracted from document)':'')});
  if(analysis.reminders.length){
    analysis.reminders.forEach(r=> S.reminders.push({id:uid(), text:r.text, dueDate:r.dueDate, done:false,
      entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, source:'Report · '+report.title, createdAt:now()}));
    saveReminders();
  }
  return false;
}
function newVersionModal(eid,rid){
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-md" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Upload new version</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleNewVersion(event,'${eid}','${rid}')">
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">File</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="file" type="file" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Version notes</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="notes" placeholder="What changed in this version"/>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Upload</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
async function handleNewVersion(ev,eid,rid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  let fileData;
  try{ fileData = await readFileAsData(f.get('file')); }catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; }
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const r = e.reports.find(x=>x.id===rid);
  const nextV = r.versions.length+1;
  r.versions.push({v:nextV, date:now(), fileName:fileData.name, fileType:fileData.type, size:fileData.size, fileData:fileData.data, uploadedBy:S.user.fullName, notes:f.get('notes')||''});
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  pushActivity({type:'report', entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`uploaded v${nextV} of "${r.title}"`});
  return false;
}
function versionHistoryModal(eid,rid){
  const e = S.entities[eid]; const r = e.reports.find(x=>x.id===rid);
  const versions = [...r.versions].sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v);
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-1">${esc(r.title)}</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-4" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Version history</div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3 mb-4" style="max-height:60vh; overflow-y:auto;">
      ${versions.map(v=>`<div class="card p-3">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
          <div class="font-semibold">Version ${v.v} — ${esc(v.fileName)}</div>
          <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${fmtDate(v.date)}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-xs mb-2" style="color:var(--text-mut)">by ${esc(v.uploadedBy)} ${v.notes?'— '+esc(v.notes):''}</div>
        ${fileChipLine({name:v.fileName,type:v.fileType,size:v.size,data:v.fileData}, null, `openModal(previewModal('${eid}','reportVersion','${rid}','${v.v}'))`)}
      </div>`).join('')}
    </div>
    <div class="flex justify-end"><button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button></div>
  </div>`;
}

  return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold">Purchase orders</div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(poModal('${e.id}'))">+ Add purchase order</button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
    ${pos.map(po=>`<div class="card p-4">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div>
          <div class="font-semibold">PO #${esc(po.poNumber||'—')} — ${esc(po.equipment)}</div>
          <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${fmtDate(po.date)} · ${esc(po.units||'—')} unit(s)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="openModal(poModal('${e.id}','${po.id}'))">Edit</button>
          ${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteRecord('${e.id}','purchaseOrders','${po.id}')">✕</button>`:''}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${po.notes?`<div class="text-sm mt-2">${esc(po.notes)}</div>`:''}
      <div class="mt-2">
        ${fileChipLine(po.files.reference,'Reference',`openModal(previewModal('${e.id}','po','${po.id}','reference'))`)}
        ${fileChipLine(po.files.datasheet,'Datasheet',`openModal(previewModal('${e.id}','po','${po.id}','datasheet'))`)}
        ${fileChipLine(po.files.poc,'PoC',`openModal(previewModal('${e.id}','po','${po.id}','poc'))`)}
      </div>
    </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No purchase orders yet.</div>`}

}
function poModal(eid,poid){
  const e = S.entities[eid]; const po = poid ? e.purchaseOrders.find(x=>x.id===poid) : null;
  const files = po ? po.files : {};
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">${po?'Edit':'Add'} purchase order</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleSavePO(event,'${eid}','${poid||''}')">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">PO Number</label><input class="input mt-1" name="poNumber" value="${po?esc(po.poNumber):''}"/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Date</label><input class="input mt-1" name="date" type="date" value="${po?po.date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}" required/></div>
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Equipment / item purchased</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="equipment" value="${po?esc(po.equipment):''}" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Units</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="units" type="number" min="1" value="${po?esc(po.units):''}"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes</label>
      <textarea class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="notes" rows="2">${po?esc(po.notes||''):''}</textarea>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-4">
        ${fileFieldBlock('reference','Reference', files.reference)}
        ${fileFieldBlock('datasheet','Datasheet', files.datasheet)}
        ${fileFieldBlock('poc','PoC', files.poc)}
      </div>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
async function handleSavePO(ev,eid,poid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const existing = poid ? e.purchaseOrders.find(x=>x.id===poid) : null;
  const filesOut = Object.assign({reference:null,datasheet:null,poc:null}, existing?existing.files:{});
  for(const key of ['reference','datasheet','poc']){
    const file = f.get(key);
    if(file && file.size){
      try{ const d = await readFileAsData(file); filesOut[key] = {name:d.name,type:d.type,size:d.size,data:d.data}; }
      catch(err){ alert(key+': '+err.message); return false; }
    }
  }
  const data = {poNumber:f.get('poNumber')||'', date:f.get('date'), equipment:f.get('equipment'), units:f.get('units')||'', notes:f.get('notes')||'', files:filesOut};
  if(poid){ Object.assign(existing, data); }
  else { e.purchaseOrders.push(Object.assign({id:uid()}, data)); }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  pushActivity({type:'purchase order', entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`logged PO for ${data.equipment}`});
  return false;
}

    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(quotationModal('${e.id}'))">+ Add quotation</button>

  <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
    ${qs.map(q=>`<div class="card p-4">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div>
          <div class="font-semibold">Quote #${esc(q.quoteNumber||'—')} — ${esc(q.item)}</div>
          <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${fmtDate(q.date)} ${q.amount?'· ₱'+Number(q.amount).toLocaleString():''} ${q.validUntil?'· valid until '+fmtDate(q.validUntil):''}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="openModal(quotationModal('${e.id}','${q.id}'))">Edit</button>

      ${q.notes?`<div class="text-sm mt-2">${esc(q.notes)}</div>`:''}
      <div class="mt-2">${fileChipLine(q.file,'Document',`openModal(previewModal('${e.id}','quotation','${q.id}'))`)}</div>
