function quotationModal(eid,qid){
  const e = S.entities[eid]; const q = qid ? e.quotations.find(x=>x.id===qid) : null;
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">${q?'Edit':'Add'} quotation</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleSaveQuotation(event,'${eid}','${qid||''}')">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Quote Number</label><input class="input mt-1" name="quoteNumber" value="${q?esc(q.quoteNumber):''}"/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Date</label><input class="input mt-1" name="date" type="date" value="${q?q.date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}" required/></div>
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Item / scope of work</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="item" value="${q?esc(q.item):''}" required/>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Amount (₱)</label><input class="input mt-1" name="amount" type="number" step="0.01" value="${q?esc(q.amount):''}"/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Valid until</label><input class="input mt-1" name="validUntil" type="date" value="${q?q.validUntil:''}"/></div>
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes</label>
      <textarea class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="notes" rows="2">${q?esc(q.notes||''):''}</textarea>
      ${fileFieldBlock('file','Quotation document', q?q.file:null)}
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end mt-4">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
async function handleSaveQuotation(ev,eid,qid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const existing = qid ? e.quotations.find(x=>x.id===qid) : null;
  let file = existing ? existing.file : null;
  const upload = f.get('file');
  if(upload && upload.size){
    try{ const d = await readFileAsData(upload); file = {name:d.name,type:d.type,size:d.size,data:d.data}; }
    catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; }
  }
  const data = {quoteNumber:f.get('quoteNumber')||'', date:f.get('date'), item:f.get('item'), amount:f.get('amount')||'', validUntil:f.get('validUntil')||'', notes:f.get('notes')||'', file};
  if(qid){ Object.assign(existing, data); }
  else { e.quotations.push(Object.assign({id:uid()}, data)); }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  pushActivity({type:'quotation', entityId:eid, entityName:e.name, by:S.user.fullName, summary:`logged quote for ${data.item}`});
  return false;
}

/* ---- TRANSACTIONS ---- */
function transactionsTab(e){
  const label = e.kind==='client' ? 'Purchases' : 'Equipment sold to Sunley';
  return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold">${label}</div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(transactionModal('${e.id}'))">+ Add entry</button>
  </div>
  <div class="card overflow-hidden">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Amount</th><th>Notes</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${e.transactions.slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.date)-new Date(a.date)).map(t=>`<tr>
          <td>${fmtDate(t.date)}</td><td>${esc(t.item)}</td><td>${esc(t.qty||'')}</td><td>${t.amount?'₱'+Number(t.amount).toLocaleString():'—'}</td><td>${esc(t.notes||'')}</td>
          <td>${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteRecord('${e.id}','transactions','${t.id}')">✕</button>`:''}</td>
        </tr>`).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No entries yet.</td></tr>`}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>`;
}
function transactionModal(eid){
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  const label = e.kind==='client'?'Purchases':'Equipment sold';
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-md" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Add ${label.toLowerCase()} entry</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleAddTransaction(event,'${eid}')">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Date</label><input class="input mt-1" name="date" type="date" value="${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}" required/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Qty</label><input class="input mt-1" name="qty" type="number" min="1"/></div>
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Item / equipment</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="item" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Amount (₱, optional)</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="amount" type="number" step="0.01"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="notes"/>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Add</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
function handleAddTransaction(ev,eid){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  e.transactions.push({id:uid(), date:f.get('date'), item:f.get('item'), qty:f.get('qty'), amount:f.get('amount'), notes:f.get('notes')});
  closeModal(); render();
  saveEntity(e);
  return false;
}

/* ---- PREDICTION ---- */
function predictionTab(e){
  const preds = computePredictions(e);
  return `<div class="mb-4">
    <div class="font-display font-semibold">Strategic pitch insight</div>
    <div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">A transparent, recency-weighted score built from your visit log outcomes — not a black-box model. Use it as a discussion starter, not a final verdict.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
    ${preds.map(p=>`<div class="card p-4 flex items-center gap-4">
      <div class="w-2 h-10 rounded-full" style="background:var(${p.colorVar})"></div>
      <div class="flex-1">
        <div class="font-semibold">${esc(p.product)}</div>
        <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${p.visits} visit${p.visits===1?'':'s'} logged · last outcome ${p.lastOutcome} on ${fmtDate(p.lastDate)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-right">
        <div class="font-display font-bold" style="color:var(${p.colorVar})">${p.label}</div>
        <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">score ${(p.score*100).toFixed(0)}/100</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Tag products in your visit logs (Visit Logs tab) to generate insight here.</div>`}
  </div>`;
}

/* ============================= DELETE GENERIC ============================= */
function deleteRecord(eid, arrName, rid){
  if(!confirm('Delete this record?')) return;
  const e = S.entities[eid];
  e[arrName] = e[arrName].filter(x=>x.id!==rid);
  render();
  saveEntity(e);
}

/* ============================= ALL REPORTS (cross-entity) ============================= */
function allReports(){
  // Entities are preloaded once in the background after login (see backgroundSync).
  // We deliberately do NOT trigger new loads from inside a render — doing that
  // previously caused a render->load->render loop that froze the tab.
  if(!S.preloaded){
    return `<div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16">
      <div class="bars"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="text-sm font-mono mt-3" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Gathering reports…</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  const rows = [];
  S.index.forEach(idx=>{
    const e = S.entities[idx.id];
    if(!e) return;
    (e.reports||[]).forEach(r=>{
      const latest = r.versions[r.versions.length-1];
      rows.push({entity:e, report:r, latest});
    });
  });
  rows.sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.latest.date)-new Date(a.latest.date));
  return `
  <div class="mb-5"><div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">All reports</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Across every client and supplier.</div></div>
  <div class="card overflow-hidden">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Type</th><th>Client/Supplier</th><th>Latest version</th><th>Uploaded</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows.map(r=>`<tr>
          <td class="font-semibold">${esc(r.report.title)}</td>
          <td><span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${esc(r.report.type)}</span></td>
          <td><span class="link" onclick="goTab('${r.entity.kind}s');openEntity('${r.entity.id}');S.entityTab='reports';">${esc(r.entity.name)}</span></td>
          <td>v${r.latest.v} — ${esc(r.latest.fileName)}</td>
          <td>${fmtDate(r.latest.date)}</td>
          <td><button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="goTab('${r.entity.kind}s');openEntity('${r.entity.id}');S.entityTab='reports';render();">Open</button></td>
        </tr>`).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No reports uploaded yet.</td></tr>`}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>`;
}

/* ============================= TELEPHONE DIRECTORY ============================= */
function telDirectory(){
  return `
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
    <div><div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">Contacts directory</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Employees, suppliers, clients and others — grouped by type, fully editable.</div></div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent no-print" onclick="openModal(directoryModal())">+ Add entry</button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 flex-wrap no-print">
    <button class="btn ${!S.dirFilter?'btn-accent':'btn-outline'} text-xs" onclick="S.dirFilter=null; byId('dirBody').innerHTML=dirBody();">All</button>
    ${Array.from(new Set([...DIRECTORY_CATEGORIES, ...S.directory.map(d=>d.category||'Other')])).map(cat=>
      `<button class="btn ${S.dirFilter===cat?'btn-accent':'btn-outline'} text-xs" onclick="S.dirFilter='${cat}'; byId('dirBody').innerHTML=dirBody();">${esc(cat)}</button>`
    ).join('')}
  </div>
  <input class="input mb-4 max-w-sm no-print" placeholder="Search directory…" value="${esc(S.dirSearch||'')}" oninput="S.dirSearch=this.value; byId('dirBody').innerHTML = dirBody();"/>
  <div id="dirBody">${dirBody()}</div>
  <div class="card p-4 text-sm mt-5">
    <div class="font-semibold mb-1">Company addresses</div>
    <div style="color:var(--text-mut)">Tahanan Village: 111 Don Rufino Avenue, Tahanan Village, Parañaque City, 1720</div>
    <div style="color:var(--text-mut)">Postal: MCPO BOX 2071, Makati 1200, Metro Manila, Philippines · MCPO BOX 2850, Makati 1200, Metro Manila, Philippines</div>
  </div>`;
}
// Rendered separately from telDirectory() so the search input above can patch
// just this container on every keystroke instead of triggering a full render()
// (which was stealing focus from the box after each character).
function dirBody(){
  const q = (S.dirSearch||'').toLowerCase();
  const matches = d => !q || (d.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (d.position||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (d.numbers||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (d.emails||'').toLowerCase().includes(q);
  const cats = Array.from(new Set([...DIRECTORY_CATEGORIES, ...S.directory.map(d=>d.category||'Other')]))
    .filter(cat => !S.dirFilter || S.dirFilter===cat);
  const sections = cats.map(cat=>{
    const rows = S.directory.filter(d=> (d.category||'Other')===cat && matches(d));
    if(!rows.length) return '';
    return `<div class="mb-5">
      <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">${esc(cat)} <span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${rows.length}</span></div>
      <div class="card overflow-hidden">
        <table>
          <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Position / Role</th><th>Number(s)</th><th>Email(s)</th><th class="no-print"></th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            ${rows.map(d=>`<tr>
              <td class="font-semibold">${esc(d.name)}</td>
              <td>${esc(d.position||'—')}</td>
              <td class="font-mono" style="max-width:280px;">${esc(d.numbers||'—')}</td>
              <td>${esc(d.emails||'—')}</td>
              <td class="text-right no-print">
                <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="openModal(directoryModal('${d.id}'))">Edit</button>
                ${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteDirectoryEntry('${d.id}')">✕</button>`:''}
              </td>
            </tr>${d.notes?`<tr><td></td><td colspan="4" class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut); border-top:none; padding-top:0;">${esc(d.notes)}</td></tr>`:''}`).join('')}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  return sections || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No matching entries.</div>`;
}
function directoryModal(id){
  const d = id ? S.directory.find(x=>x.id===id) : null;
  const cat = d ? (d.category||'Other') : 'Employee';
  const isCustomCat = !DIRECTORY_CATEGORIES.includes(cat);
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-md" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">${d?'Edit':'Add'} directory entry</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleSaveDirectory(event,'${id||''}')">
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Type</label>
      <select class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="category" onchange="byId('otherDirCat').style.display=this.value==='Other'?'block':'none'">
        ${DIRECTORY_CATEGORIES.map(c=>`<option value="${c}" ${cat===c||(c==='Other'&&isCustomCat)?'selected':''}>${c}</option>`).join('')}
      </select>
      <input id="otherDirCat" class="input mb-3" name="otherCategory" placeholder="Specify type" value="${isCustomCat?esc(cat):''}" style="display:${isCustomCat?'block':'none'}"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Name</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="name" value="${d?esc(d.name):''}" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Position / Role</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="position" value="${d?esc(d.position||''):''}" placeholder="e.g. Management, Sales Engineer, Procurement"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Number(s)</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="numbers" value="${d?esc(d.numbers||''):''}" placeholder="Network: number, comma separated"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Email(s)</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="emails" value="${d?esc(d.emails||''):''}"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="notes" value="${d?esc(d.notes||''):''}"/>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
function handleSaveDirectory(ev,id){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  let category = f.get('category'); if(category==='Other' && f.get('otherCategory')) category = f.get('otherCategory');
  const data = {category, name:f.get('name'), position:f.get('position'), numbers:f.get('numbers'), emails:f.get('emails'), notes:f.get('notes')};
  if(id){ Object.assign(S.directory.find(x=>x.id===id), data); }
  else { S.directory.push(Object.assign({id:uid()}, data)); }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveDirectory();
  pushActivity({type:'directory', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:'Tel. Directory', summary:`${id?'updated':'added'} entry ${data.name} (${category})`});
  return false;
}
function deleteDirectoryEntry(id){
  if(!confirm('Delete this directory entry?')) return;
  const d = S.directory.find(x=>x.id===id);
  S.directory = S.directory.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  render();
  saveDirectory();
  pushActivity({type:'directory', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:'Tel. Directory', summary:`removed entry ${d?d.name:''}`});
}

/* ============================= SIMs DATABASE ============================= */
function simsDatabase(){
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  return `
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
    <div><div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">SIMs database</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Internet data SIM inventory, per carrier.</div></div>
    <div class="flex gap-2 no-print">
      <button class="btn btn-gold" onclick="exportSimExcel()">⬇ Download Excel</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="printSims()">🖶 Print</button>
      <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(simModal())">+ Add SIM</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="flex gap-1 mb-4 border-b no-print" style="border-color:var(--border)">
    ${CARRIERS.map(c=>`<div class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer" style="color:${S.simCarrier===c?'var(--accent)':'var(--text-mut)'};border-bottom:2px solid ${S.simCarrier===c?'var(--accent)':'transparent'}" onclick="S.simCarrier='${c}';S.simSearch='';render();">${CARRIER_LABELS[c]}</div>`).join('')}
  </div>
  <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-3 print-only" style="display:none;">${CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]} ETPI Internet Data SIM — as of ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-PH',{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'})}</div>
  <input class="input mb-3 max-w-sm no-print" placeholder="Search order #, mobile, ICCID…" value="${esc(S.simSearch||'')}" oninput="S.simSearch=this.value; byId('simsBody').innerHTML = simsBody();"/>
  <div id="simsBody">${simsBody()}</div>`;
}
// Stats + table only — refreshed directly by the search input above without a
// full render() so the cursor never jumps out of the search box while typing.
function simsBody(){
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  const all = S.sims[carrier]||[];
  const q = (S.simSearch||'').toLowerCase();
  const rows = all.filter(r=>{
    if(!q) return true;
    return [r.order,r.mobile,r.iccid].some(v=> String(v==null?'':v).toLowerCase().includes(q));
  });
  const pending = all.filter(r=>!r.mobile).length;
  const pdis = all.filter(r=>r.mobile && String(r.remaining||'').toUpperCase()==='PDIS').length;
  const active = all.filter(r=>r.mobile && String(r.remaining||'').toUpperCase()!=='PDIS').length;
  return `
  <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-4">
    ${statCard('Active', active,'●','--success')}
    ${statCard('PDIS', pdis,'◐','--warn')}
    ${statCard('Pending delivery', pending,'○','--danger')}
    ${statCard('Cut-off rule', CARRIER_CUTOFF_LABEL[carrier],'◷','--gold')}
  </div>
  <div class="card overflow-hidden">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>No.</th><th>Order #</th><th>Mobile Number</th><th>ICCID</th><th>Cut-off</th><th>Coverage</th><th>Remaining</th><th>Received</th><th>Delivered</th><th class="no-print"></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr>
          <td>${i+1}</td><td>${esc(r.order??'')}</td><td class="font-mono">${esc(r.mobile||'—')}</td><td class="font-mono">${esc(r.iccid||'—')}</td>
          <td>${CARRIER_CUTOFF_LABEL[carrier]}</td><td>${esc(r.coverage||'—')}</td><td>${esc(r.remaining??'—')}</td>
          <td>${esc(r.received||'—')}</td><td>${esc(r.delivered||'—')}</td>
          <td class="no-print">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="openModal(simModal('${r.id}'))">Edit</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="openModal(simHistoryModal('${r.id}'))">History${r.history&&r.history.length?` (${r.history.length})`:''}</button>
            ${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteSim('${r.id}')">✕</button>`:''}
          </td>
        </tr>`).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="10" class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No SIM records.</td></tr>`}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>`;
}
function simModal(id){
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  const r = id ? S.sims[carrier].find(x=>x.id===id) : null;
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-1">${r?'Edit':'Add'} ${CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]} SIM</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-4" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Leave Mobile Number and ICCID blank to log this as pending delivery under the order number.</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleSaveSim(event,'${id||''}')">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Order Number</label><input class="input mt-1" name="order" value="${r?esc(r.order):''}" required/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Mobile Number</label><input class="input mt-1" name="mobile" value="${r?esc(r.mobile||''):''}"/></div>
      </div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">ICCID Number</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="iccid" value="${r?esc(r.iccid||''):''}"/>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div>
          <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Cut-off</label>
          <div class="input mt-1" style="background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); font-weight:600;">${CARRIER_CUTOFF_LABEL[carrier]}</div>
        </div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Remaining Months / Status</label><input class="input mt-1" name="remaining" value="${r?esc(r.remaining??''):''}" placeholder="e.g. 6 or PDIS"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-xs mb-3" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Remaining months auto-deduct by 1 each time this SIM's carrier cut-off passes — every change (auto or manual) is kept in this SIM's History.</div>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Data SIM Coverage (validity period)</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="coverage" value="${r?esc(r.coverage||''):''}" placeholder="e.g. 1 Jan 2027 - 31 Dec 2027"/>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">STC-SIM Received Date</label><input class="input mt-1" name="received" value="${r?esc(r.received||''):''}" placeholder="e.g. 01 December, 2025"/></div>
        <div><label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">SIM Delivery Date to Customer</label><input class="input mt-1" name="delivered" value="${r?esc(r.delivered||''):''}" placeholder="e.g. 01 December, 2025"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Apply</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
function handleSaveSim(ev,id){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  const data = {order:f.get('order'), mobile:f.get('mobile')||'', iccid:f.get('iccid')||'',
    coverage:f.get('coverage')||'', remaining:f.get('remaining')||'', received:f.get('received')||'', delivered:f.get('delivered')||''};
  if(id){
    const existing = S.sims[carrier].find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(String(existing.remaining??'') !== String(data.remaining??'')){
      existing.history = existing.history || [];
      existing.history.push({date:now(), from:existing.remaining, to:data.remaining, by:S.user.fullName, note:'Manually updated'});
    }
    Object.assign(existing, data);
  } else {
    S.sims[carrier].push(Object.assign({id:uid(), history:[], lastDeduction:null}, data));
  }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveSims();
  pushActivity({type:'sim', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]+' SIMs', summary:`${id?'updated':'added'} SIM ${data.mobile||'(pending) — order '+data.order}`});
  return false;
}
function simHistoryModal(id){
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  const r = S.sims[carrier].find(x=>x.id===id);
  const hist = r && r.history ? [...r.history].reverse() : [];
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-lg" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-1">${CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]} SIM — ${esc(r?r.mobile||r.order:'')}</div>
    <div class="text-xs mb-4" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Remaining-months history — auto-deductions and manual edits, most recent first.</div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 mb-4" style="max-height:55vh; overflow-y:auto;">
      ${hist.map(h=>`<div class="card p-3 text-sm">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span class="font-semibold">${esc(h.from)} → ${esc(h.to)}</span>
          <span class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${fmtDateTime(h.date)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="text-xs mt-1" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${esc(h.note||'')} ${h.by?'· '+esc(h.by):''}</div>
      </div>`).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No changes logged yet.</div>`}
    </div>
    <div class="flex justify-end"><button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button></div>
  </div>`;
}
function deleteSim(id){
  if(!confirm('Delete this SIM record?')) return;
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  S.sims[carrier] = S.sims[carrier].filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  render();
  saveSims();
}
function exportSimExcel(){
  const carrier = S.simCarrier;
  const rows = S.sims[carrier]||[];
  const pending = rows.filter(r=>!r.mobile).length;
  const pdis = rows.filter(r=>r.mobile && String(r.remaining||'').toUpperCase()==='PDIS').length;
  const active = rows.filter(r=>r.mobile && String(r.remaining||'').toUpperCase()!=='PDIS').length;
  const aoa = [
    ['Sunley Technology Corporation'],
    [`${CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]} ETPI Internet Data SIM — as of ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-PH',{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'})}`],
    [`Total Active ${CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]} SIM - ${active}`],
    [`Total PDIS SIM - ${pdis}`],
    [`Total Pending SIM - ${pending}`],
    [],
    ['No.','Order Number','Mobile Number','ICCID Number','Cut-off Date','Data SIM Coverage','Remaining Months','STC-SIM Received Date','SIM Delivery Date to Customer'],
  ];
  rows.forEach((r,i)=> aoa.push([i+1, r.order||'', r.mobile||'', r.iccid||'', CARRIER_CUTOFF_LABEL[carrier], r.coverage||'', r.remaining||'', r.received||'', r.delivered||'']));
  const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(aoa);
  ws['!cols'] = [{wch:5},{wch:12},{wch:15},{wch:26},{wch:18},{wch:30},{wch:16},{wch:20},{wch:24}];
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]);
  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `${CARRIER_LABELS[carrier]}_ETPI_SIM_Database_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.xlsx`);
}
function printSims(){ window.print(); }

/* ============================= REPORT FORMATS (template library) ============================= */
function templatesPage(){
  const cats = REPORT_TYPES;
  const counts = {};
  cats.forEach(c=>counts[c]=0);
  S.templates.forEach(t=>{ counts[t.category] = (counts[t.category]||0)+1; });
  return `
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
    <div><div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">Report formats</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Blank formats and templates staff can download and use — organized by report type, with a live summary per category.</div></div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(templateModal())">+ Add format</button>
  </div>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-6">
    ${cats.map((c,i)=>`<div class="card card-hover p-4 text-center">
      <div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold" style="color:var(${i%2?'--gold':'--accent'})">${counts[c]||0}</div>
      <div class="text-xs mt-1" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${c}</div>
    </div>`).join('')}
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-6">
    ${cats.filter(c=>S.templates.some(t=>t.category===c)).map(c=>`
      <div>
        <div class="font-display font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">${c} <span class="badge" style="background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold)">${counts[c]} format${counts[c]===1?'':'s'}</span></div>
        <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
          ${S.templates.filter(t=>t.category===c).map(t=>`<div class="card p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <div class="flex-1" style="min-width:220px;">
              <div class="font-semibold text-sm">${esc(t.title)}</div>
              ${t.notes?`<div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${esc(t.notes)}</div>`:''}
              ${t.summary?`<div class="text-xs mt-1" style="color:var(--text-mut); white-space:pre-line;">${esc(t.summary)}</div>`:''}
              <div class="text-xs mt-1" style="color:var(--text-mut)">uploaded by ${esc(t.uploadedBy)} · ${fmtDate(t.uploadedAt)}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              ${fileChipLine(t.file, null, `openModal(previewModal(null,'template','${t.id}'))`)}
              ${can('deleteRecord')?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="deleteTemplate('${t.id}')">✕</button>`:''}
            </div>
          </div>`).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('') || `<div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">No formats uploaded yet — add your first blank Visit Report or Acknowledgement template above.</div>`}
  </div>`;
}
function templateModal(){
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-md" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Add report format</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleAddTemplate(event)">
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Category</label>
      <select class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="category" onchange="byId('otherTplCat').style.display=this.value==='Other'?'block':'none'">
        ${REPORT_TYPES.map(t=>`<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('')}
      </select>
      <input id="otherTplCat" class="input mb-3" name="otherCategory" placeholder="Specify category" style="display:none"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Title</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="title" placeholder="e.g. Visit Report — blank format" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Notes</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="notes" placeholder="Optional"/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Contents summary (optional)</label>
      <textarea class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="summary" rows="3" placeholder="Briefly list what sections/fields this format contains — helps the AI Assistant answer questions about it"></textarea>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">File</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="file" type="file" required/>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Upload</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
async function handleAddTemplate(ev){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  let category = f.get('category'); if(category==='Other' && f.get('otherCategory')) category = f.get('otherCategory');
  let fileData;
  try{ fileData = await readFileAsData(f.get('file')); }catch(err){ alert(err.message); return false; }
  S.templates.push({id:uid(), category, title:f.get('title'), notes:f.get('notes')||'', summary:f.get('summary')||'',
    file:{name:fileData.name,type:fileData.type,size:fileData.size,data:fileData.data},
    uploadedBy:S.user.fullName, uploadedAt:now()});
  closeModal(); render();
  stSet('report_templates', S.templates, true);
  pushActivity({type:'report format', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:'Report Formats', summary:`uploaded "${f.get('title')}" (${category})`});
  return false;
}
function deleteTemplate(id){
  if(!confirm('Delete this format?')) return;
  const t = S.templates.find(x=>x.id===id);
  S.templates = S.templates.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  render();
  stSet('report_templates', S.templates, true);
  pushActivity({type:'report format', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:'Report Formats', summary:`removed "${t?t.title:''}"`});
}

/* ============================= USERS ADMIN ============================= */
function usersAdmin(){
  return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
    <div><div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">Employee accounts</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Manage who can log in and their access level.</div></div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="openModal(userModal())">+ Add employee</button>
  </div>
  <div class="card overflow-hidden">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Username</th><th>Role</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${S.users.map(u=>`<tr>
          <td>${esc(u.fullName)}</td><td class="font-mono">${esc(u.username)}</td><td class="capitalize">${esc(u.role)}</td>
          <td class="text-right">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" onclick="openModal(userModal('${u.id}'))">Edit</button>
            ${u.id!==S.user.id?`<button class="btn btn-ghost text-xs" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="handleDeleteUser('${u.id}')">Remove</button>`:''}
          </td>
        </tr>`).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div class="text-xs mt-4" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Note: this is a lightweight, browser-side login for internal demo/prototype use. For production use with real employees, credentials should move to a proper backend authentication service.</div>`;
}
function userModal(uid_){
  const u = uid_ ? S.users.find(x=>x.id===uid_) : null;
  return `<div class="card p-6 w-full max-w-sm" style="background:var(--bg-alt)" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="font-display text-lg font-semibold mb-4">${u?'Edit':'Add'} employee</div>
    <form onsubmit="return handleSaveUser(event,'${uid_||''}')">
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Full name</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="fullName" value="${u?esc(u.fullName):''}" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Username</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="username" value="${u?esc(u.username):''}" required/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Password</label>
      <input class="input mt-1 mb-3" name="password" placeholder="${u?'Leave blank to keep current':''}" ${u?'':'required'}/>
      <label class="text-xs font-semibold" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Role</label>
      <select class="input mt-1 mb-4" name="role">
        <option value="staff" ${u&&u.role==='staff'?'selected':''}>Staff</option>
        <option value="manager" ${u&&u.role==='manager'?'selected':''}>Manager</option>
        <option value="admin" ${u&&u.role==='admin'?'selected':''}>Admin</option>
      </select>
      <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" type="submit">Save</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>`;
}
function handleSaveUser(ev,uid_){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const f = new FormData(ev.target);
  const fullName = f.get('fullName'), username = f.get('username'), role = f.get('role');
  if(uid_){
    const u = S.users.find(x=>x.id===uid_);
    u.fullName=fullName; u.username=username; u.role=role;
    if(f.get('password')) u.password=f.get('password');
  } else {
    S.users.push({id:uid(), fullName, username, password:f.get('password'), role});
  }
  closeModal(); render();
  saveUsers();
  pushActivity({type:'user', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:'Employee Accounts', summary:`${uid_?'updated':'added'} employee ${fullName} (${role})`});
  return false;
}
function handleDeleteUser(uid_){
  if(!confirm('Remove this employee account?')) return;
  const u = S.users.find(x=>x.id===uid_);
  S.users = S.users.filter(x=>x.id!==uid_);
  render();
  saveUsers();
  pushActivity({type:'user', by:S.user.fullName, entityName:'Employee Accounts', summary:`removed employee account ${u?u.username:''}`});
}

  return `<div class="mb-5"><div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">Help guide</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">How to use the Sunley field marketing database.</div></div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-4 max-w-2xl">
    ${helpItem('Adding a client or supplier','Go to Clients or Suppliers in the sidebar, then "+ Add". You can attach a logo image right away or later from the profile’s "Edit profile" button.')}
    ${helpItem('Logging a visit','Open a client/supplier profile → Visit Logs tab → "+ Add log". Record the date, location, who attended, the outcome, and which products were pitched — tagging products here is what powers the Strategic Insight tab. The notes box is scanned automatically for follow-up actions and dates ("call back tomorrow", "send quote by Aug 25") to raise as Dashboard reminders — it\'s keyword pattern-matching, not a language model, so check anything it flags.')}
    ${helpItem('Uploading reports','Open a profile → Reports tab → "+ New report". Pick a type (or "Other" to specify your own), attach a file (PDF, Word, Excel or image, up to 2MB), and it becomes version 1. For .docx files, the document\'s own text is scanned alongside the optional notes box for the same follow-up detection. Use "Upload new version" on the same report to keep a full version history without losing older files.')}
    ${helpItem('Contacts and products','Add the people in charge (with email, phone, WhatsApp, Viber) under the Contacts tab, and the equipment involved under the Products tab. Each product can carry its own photo, description, notes, and attached datasheet, reference and manual files.')}
    ${helpItem('Quotations','Every client and supplier profile has a Quotations tab — log the quote number, date, item/scope, amount, validity, and attach the quotation document itself.')}
    ${helpItem('Purchase orders (clients)','Client profiles have a Purchase Orders tab — log the PO number, date, equipment and units purchased, plus reference, datasheet and PoC (proof of concept) files.')}
    ${helpItem('Purchases / equipment sold','For clients this tracks what they’ve bought from Sunley; for suppliers it tracks equipment sold to Sunley. Add entries manually under the respective tab.')}
    ${helpItem('Report formats','The sidebar’s "Report Formats" section is a library of blank templates (Visit Report, Acknowledgement, Monthly Equipment Sales Report, etc.) staff can download and reuse — separate from the reports already filled out per client/supplier. Each category shows a running count, and each format can carry a contents summary.')}
    ${helpItem('AI Business Assistant','The "AI Assistant" section shows a data-driven "Top opportunities" and "Quotations expiring soon" panel computed directly from your visit logs and quotations, alongside a live chat assistant for open-ended questions.')}
    ${helpItem('World clock','The "World Clock" section shows the current time in Manila (highlighted as the home base) alongside the UK, US, and other regions Sunley regularly deals with — handy for scheduling calls with overseas suppliers or contacts.')}
    ${helpItem('Activity log','The "Activity Log" section records who logged in and every add, edit, delete or file upload across the database, with a timestamp — a running audit trail. The Dashboard also shows the 8 most recent entries.')}
    ${helpItem('Contacts directory','The sidebar’s "Contacts" section holds every phone/email contact — employees, suppliers, clients, and any other type you add — grouped into sections with a running count each, searchable and fully editable.')}
    ${helpItem('Dashboard reminders & summaries','The Dashboard\'s "Reminders" panel surfaces follow-up actions detected in visit log and report notes (things like "follow up next Tuesday" or "send quote by Aug 25"), with a checkbox to dismiss once done. The "Recent report summaries" panel breaks each entry into Accomplished / Next steps / Remember. Both are rule-based keyword matching, not true document understanding — they\'re a first pass to catch things, not a replacement for reading the actual note.')}
    ${helpItem('SIMs database','Under "SIMs Database", switch between the Globe, Smart and DITO tabs to manage each carrier’s SIM inventory separately. Add a SIM under an existing or new order number — leave the mobile number blank to log it as pending delivery. "Remaining Months" auto-deducts by one every time that carrier’s cut-off passes — the 10th of the month for Globe, the last day of the month for Smart and DITO — and every change (automatic or manual) is kept in that SIM’s "History". "Download Excel" exports the current table to a spreadsheet, and "Print" opens your browser’s print dialog for a clean printout.')}
    ${helpItem('Strategic Insight','A transparent score is calculated from your visit log outcomes for each product, weighted toward more recent visits. It flags each pitch as "Keep pushing", "Monitor / reassess" or "Reconsider pitch" — meant to support discussion, not replace judgment.')}
    ${helpItem('Access levels','Staff can add and edit records. Managers can also delete records and profiles. Admins additionally manage employee accounts under "Employee Accounts".')}
    ${helpItem('Search','Use the search bar at the top to jump straight to any client or supplier by name.')}
  </div>`;
}
function helpItem(title,body){
  return `<div class="card p-4"><div class="font-semibold mb-1">${title}</div><div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${body}</div></div>`;
}

/* ============================= WORLD CLOCK ============================= */
function timezonesPage(){
  return `
  <div class="mb-5">
    <div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold">World clock</div>
    <div class="text-sm" style="color:var(--text-mut)">Manila time first — useful when coordinating with overseas suppliers and contacts.</div>
  </div>
  <div id="tzGrid" class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">${renderTzCards()}</div>`;
}
function renderTzCards(){
  const nowD = new Date();
  return TIMEZONES.map(tz=>{
    let timeStr, dateStr;
    try{
      timeStr = nowD.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {timeZone:tz.zone, hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit', second:'2-digit', hour12:true});
      dateStr = nowD.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {timeZone:tz.zone, weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric'});
    }catch(e){ timeStr='—'; dateStr=''; }
    return `<div class="card ${tz.priority?'card-hover':''} p-5" style="${tz.priority?'border-top:3px solid var(--gold); background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--card));':''}">
      ${tz.priority?`<span class="badge mb-2" style="background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold)">Home base</span>`:''}
      <div class="font-display text-2xl font-bold font-mono">${timeStr}</div>
      <div class="text-sm font-semibold mt-1">${tz.label}</div>
      <div class="text-xs" style="color:var(--text-mut)">${dateStr}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
// Keeps the World Clock ticking without a full page render — cheap no-op when
// the tab isn't open since it just checks whether #tzGrid exists in the DOM.
function startClockTick(){
  setInterval(()=>{
    const g = byId('tzGrid');
    if(g) g.innerHTML = renderTzCards();
  }, 1000);
}

  </div>
  <div class="card overflow-hidden">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Type</th><th>Who</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead>

          <td class="text-xs" style="white-space:nowrap;">${fmtDateTime(a.at)}</td>
          <td><span class="badge" style="background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)">${esc(a.type)}</span></td>
          <td>${esc(a.by)}</td>
          <td>${a.entityId?`<span class="link" onclick="openEntity('${a.entityId}')">${esc(a.entityName)}</span> — `:(a.entityName?esc(a.entityName)+' — ':'')}${esc(a.summary)}</td>

/* ============================= GLOBAL HANDLERS ============================= */
function attachGlobalHandlers(){
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(!e.target.closest('#searchBox') && !e.target.closest('#searchDropdown')){
      S.searchQ='';
      const dd = byId('searchDropdown'); if(dd) dd.innerHTML='';
    }
  }, {once:true});
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
